name: Consistent elaboration with respect to states, inputs and outputs
description: Exercise 4.74: given functions HS, HI, HO with RNG(HS) = SZ1, RNG(HI) = IZ1, RNG(HO) = OZ1 and choice functions CHS ∈ CHF(DMN(HS)), CHO ∈ CHF(DMN(HO)), the system Z2 = (DMN(HS), DMN(HI), DMN(HO), NZ2, RZ2) with NZ2(x,p) = CHS(HS⁻¹(NZ1(HS(x),HI(p)))) and RZ2(x) = CHO(HO⁻¹(RZ1(HS(x)))) satisfies Z2 ∈ DSYSTEMS, #SZ2 ≥ #SZ1, #IZ2 ≥ #IZ1, #OZ2 ≥ #OZ1 and Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, HS, HI, HO).

elements.text: The three functions onto SZ1, IZ1 and OZ1 whose domains are the state, input and output sets of Z2.
Z2 = (DMN(HS), DMN(HI), DMN(HO), NZ2, RZ2) where NZ2 and RZ2 choose preimages of the corresponding values of Z1.
The chosen preimages are genuine preimages, so HS, HI and HO intertwine the dynamics.
Z2 ∈ DSYSTEMS, #SZ2 ≥ #SZ1, #IZ2 ≥ #IZ1, #OZ2 ≥ #OZ1 and Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, HS, HI, HO).
